items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and reject new spend, monetization expansion, revenue forecasts, ROI, margin, payback, and causal-lift claims. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The 18 named tracking rows show $0 site-attributed income; the $4.92 aggregate row cannot be assigned to a site. AI usage cost is $928.5425623 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-29 across 5,097 calls and 39 instrumented sites, but it is not period-matched to the revenue data and infrastructure, labor, and other operating costs are unavailable. Contribution margin, cost-to-learn, budget exposure, payback, and forecasts are therefore not calculable. Continue the existing report-only reconciliation; minimum measurement is period-aligned site/content attribution plus complete matching-period AI, infrastructure, labor, operating-cost, commitment, budget-ceiling, and approved learning-threshold fields. Do not extrapolate one-day revenue or September AI cost.

Push back on vanity metrics: clicks, impressions, sessions, conversions, ordered items, shipped items, proposal counts, and proven operational outcomes do not establish revenue quality, contribution margin, or return. Preserve the aggregate $4.92 as unattributed and treat unavailable values as unknown rather than zero.
